rows.quote: GWAS summary statistics for CAD were obtained from a GWAS meta-analysis in CARDIoGRAMplusC4D (including UK Biobank), which involved 122,733 cases and 424,528 controls, primarily of European ancestry [16].
rows.reference_quote: van der Harst P, Verweij N. Identification of 64 novel genetic loci provides an expanded view on the genetic architecture of coronary artery disease. Circ Res. 2018;122(3):433–43.
rows.coder_note: Step 2 (rules C5, E): the sentence attributes the CAD GWAS to reference 16, whose DOI 10.1161/circresaha.117.312086 is the source of two outcome rows (the UK Biobank + CARDIoGRAMplusC4D meta-analysis and the UK Biobank-only GWAS); the pinned sentence's 'meta-analysis in CARDIoGRAMplusC4D (including UK Biobank)' with 122,733 cases and 424,528 controls separates them (the UK Biobank-only row has 34,541 / 261,984). Coded row is outside the listed candidates; the Nikpay 2015 candidate is not cited. No accession.

rows.quote: We used GWAS data from the discovery cohort which were restricted to participants of European ancestry (n = 34,557).
